title: CE: refresh validation pack with scoped evidence and untested rows
public_pr_body:
Refreshes the #258 validation pack onto the unmerged CA to CD integration d73bb240a23b38a7080c0933e4f5b62ddd529f5f, based on #247 41c685c416305637d86b580324fff9e6cda037ff. Adds required JNR 140/141, reconciliation and release-gate traceability: 15 URS/OQ rows, 6 IQ and 9 PQ rows. Original #258 branch is unchanged.

Assumption: review the refreshed pack on this stacked integration, not declare an approved production head. Every DB, browser, provider and complete OQ/PQ result remains NOT TESTED. Only scoped actual local evidence is filled; IQ-001 is local checkout identification only. VSR decision and Rhys signature remain blank. RHYS-ACTIONS.md lists every acceptance still required.

Evidence: frozen code full suite 5567 passed, 0 failed/skipped. CE mapped units 463 passed across 36 files, 0 failed/skipped/todo on clean 18aa60d51e1eec511517dede02c461c688bbad8a with dated hashes/logs. Pack mapping and typecheck pass. Correction: initial no-argument npm lint was not meaningful file coverage. CI audit explicit eslint app/components/lib on this exact e71a800 head checks 633 files, 0 errors and 3 recorded warnings; those warnings remain visible in the final audit. Final-head complete-suite rerun is the CI job. Docker ENOSPC blocked backend start, not a passing DB result; exact combined #250 wipe, #207 and unrun reviewer DB proofs remain blocked. No real-data SQL or production changes.
